question: Where does the time-drawing goddess draw time?
premises: At the nose-tip is threefold time.
The time-drawing goddess is always mouth-situated.
Calculating breath and inbreath, she draws in the heart.
inference: The time-drawing goddess, always situated in the mouth and calculating breath, draws threefold time in the heart.
uncertainties: The exact relation of nāsāgre to kālaṃ is compressed.
plain_english: At the nose-tip is threefold time; the time-drawing goddess, always situated in the mouth and calculating breath and inbreath, draws in the heart.
